reviews.text:
I truly cannot recommend Wesley enough! He’s been training my Irish doodle since I first got her, starting with individual lessons, and most recently she did a 16 day board and train with him. When I got her back, it was like I got a brand new dog.

She is SO much calmer, more engaged with me, listens so much better, and has learned how to control her impulses. She can hold place for HOURS sometimes until I break her, she’s learned how to heel, and overall she actually listens to me and looks to me for direction now. Is she perfect? Of course not - she’s only a 6 month old puppy but the difference in her is honestly incredible.

Wesley literally speaks dog. He understands them on another level, but what I appreciate just as much is how much he teaches YOU as the owner.He answers every single question I have, and I have a lot; explains why she’s doing what she’s doing, and teaches me how to communicate with her.

If you want a dog that listens AND you want to build the best possible relationship with your dog, hire Wesley. Seriously. Worth every penny!

Cannot say enough good things about my experience with Good DaweG! My now 8 month old aussiedoodle has been to two separate board and trains with Wesley and he has learned so so much! From the start, my dog felt comfortable with him and was very receptive towards him, and Wesley always made sure I knew how to continue Dash's training on my own at home! Wesley is an incredible trainer and I couldn't recommend him enough. If you are considering taking your dog to him, this is your sign to do it!

We had a fantastic experience with Good Daweg! Wesley was great to work with and took our dog, Sadie, out to different places for real-world exposure while building solid basic commands. Since finishing her training, Sadie seems much more chill, happy, and confident. We are thrilled with the results and would absolutely recommend Good Daweg to anyone looking for effective, thoughtful dog training in Houston!

I recently enrolled my 6-month-old Goldendoodle, Nyla, in Wesley's hybrid training program, which included a two-week board-and-train and five private lessons. Throughout the entire process, I was incredibly impressed with both the training and communication.

During the board-and-train, I had the opportunity to visit Wesley and see Nyla's progress firsthand. Wesley is truly exceptional when it comes to training dogs and helping owners understand their dog's behavior. He consistently kept me updated by sending videos of Nyla's training sessions, along with demonstrations of how he corrected behaviors. These videos helped me better understand how to reinforce commands and address issues at home.

What sets Wesley apart is that he doesn't just train your dog...he takes the time to educate and train the owner as well. His approach is thorough, professional, and tailored to ensure long-term success for both the dog and the family.

I would 100% recommend Wesley and Good Dawg to anyone looking for respectful, effective, and comprehensive dog training. The results speak for themselves, and the knowledge and support he provides are invaluable. 10/10, highly recommend!

We enrolled our Standard Poodle puppy, Ruby, in Wesley’s in-home training program, and it was one of the best decisions we’ve made. Wesley is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and practical in his approach. He didn’t just train Ruby—he trained us, too.

Ruby came to us full of energy and puppy mischief, and Wesley helped us establish structure, consistency, and effective communication. Because the training took place in our home environment, the lessons were immediately applicable to our daily routine and the challenges we were actually facing.

Wesley was always responsive, encouraging, and invested in our success. We saw significant improvements in Ruby’s obedience, behavior, and overall ability to settle and listen. The tools and techniques he taught us continue to make a difference every day.

If you’re looking for a dog trainer who is professional, knowledgeable, and truly cares about helping both dogs and their families succeed, I highly recommend Wesley.

I had Jasper, my 9 month old German Shepherd/Great Pyrenees mix, for a 2-week board and train with Anthony. Anthony offered great advice along the way and Jasper came back having learned so much! Stay, place, heel, and improved impulse control. I mainly wanted work with excited reactivity to other dogs, which they said could take longer than 2-weeks to accomplish. Jasper is much more manageable after spending time with Anthony, in regards to reactivity. I am very pleased with my experience and with Anthony! He is a true dog whisperer!

Truly cannot say enough good things about my experience working with Wesley. I sent Bodie for a 3 week board & train. Getting him in was so easy, & the communication was fantastic. Wesley even provided tips to try in the brief period before Bodie was with him. I received regular updates & check-ins. Even now that Bodie is home, Wesley still checks in & offers advice. Bodie went from being very high strung & excited reactive with almost no impulse control to now he can go on off-leash adventures and be an all around better citizen.

Good DaweG is the best place for dog training! 5 stars all day. Wesley is amazing with dogs and pups. His passion and commitment to his work is evident with his training skills. Thanks to Wesley, we can now confidently take our dog, Omer, everywhere we go. Omer stays so well behaved in public, out to dinner, in crowded places, and he goes to work daily with us. 🙏❤️ Highly recommended dog trainer in Houston!

I took my 10-week-old Bernedoodle puppy, Roux, to spend two weeks with Wesley at Good DaweG for a board-and-train, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Wesley was incredibly professional and amazing to work with from start to finish. He communicated often with updates, photos, and videos showing Roux’s progress and how she was adjusting, which gave me so much peace of mind.
After having a poor experience with a breeder-recommended trainer for our last dog, Wesley was truly a breath of fresh air. His approach is patient, consistent, and clearly rooted in a genuine love for dogs.
We’ve had Roux home for a couple of weeks now, and she’s doing incredible- confident, well-mannered, and eager to learn. She’s even been teaching her big sister, Winnie, some of the good habits she picked up from Wesley! I’ll be taking both of my dogs back to him once the youngest is six months old for obedience training. I would recommend Good DaweG to anyone looking for a trustworthy, skilled, and caring trainer.

Did a 1 week board and train for my 5 month cane corso and Wesley was responsive with updates and took time to share advice (and even concerns) during and after the boarding. He seems to genuinely love his job and it shows. Will enroll my other pups as well.

My initial encounter with Wesley of Good DaweG was private  training for my puppy Jewel. I then left my puppy for a 21 day board and train while I traveled a few weeks ago. Anthony is the person who primarily boarded and  trained her. I received regular update videos and saw how Jewel transformed into a more controlled and obedient puppy. When I got home, my puppy was not as responsive to my commands as she was with Anthony.  I messaged Anthony and expressed my concerns. He came to my home and spent 2+ hours with me and my puppy Jewel going through commands and correcting behavior.  I have since continued to reinforce her training. I took Jewel out to a crowed area yesterday and others commented that she was a well behaved dog. It is a work in progress, but she is improving every day.  I will continue to train with Good Daweg. Thank you Wesley and Anthony... The Good Daweg team. Jewel sends a tali wag.

Wesley did a phenomenal job! He was incredibly knowledgeable and gave us amazing tools to help make our boys the best they can be. The one hour he spent here has already made a huge impact, our dogs were noticeably more well-behaved by the time he left. He worked on leash training and teaching them not to bolt out the door.Amazingly, we can see progress right away. I could not recommend him more and can’t wait for future sessions to keep building on the lessons!

Do not take your dog here! My dog didn’t learn anything new. He knew all basic commands and more. Plus he came home with parasites in his stool which he did NOT have when dropped off. He also came home with a lot of weight loss. He did not treat my boy with respect or love.

We are very pleased with the results of the Good DaweG three-week board and train program. Wesley communicates promptly and clearly. His program is based out of his home, which has a very large yard. Our girl, Gracey, is a Pittie mix rescue. Apparently, she has somewhat of an intimidating appearance to some people. A few other train & board facilities we looked at were clearly apprehensive and guarded during our initial meet and greet. It was a completely different experience meeting Wesley for the first time. He was comfortable, and treated Gracey as he would a Poodle, or Labrador. Gracey picked up on it, and was showing him affection after a few minutes. Part of the training process was Wesley taking Gracey out to public parks and Home Depot. That was invaluable for us to see our dog behaving calmly and obeying commands while immersed in distracting real life situations. Now we have confidence in our dog, and feel comfortable taking her out to busy places. It was totally worth the money. We feel like we have a solid foundation to build upon.  We can’t recommend Good DaweG enough!

Wesley is absolutely amazing! He went above and beyond our expectations during the online training sessions and the board and train process. He helped our dog not just have more confidence but to open up and not be scared of everything around him. The way Wesley dedicated his time and knowledge allowed Ace to build trust and confidence right off the bat. Wesley traveled to California to bring Ace back to us to help get him acclimated to his environment and teach us the skills, commands, and confidence to ensure we could continue building Ace up and set him up for success. Wesley taught us in ways that we understood, and had us demonstrate so he could make sure we could carry on the training. He was very easy to work with from start to finish, we are so glad we decided to work together! Could not recommend him more!!

Wesley at Good Daweg has been immensely helpful with training my golden retriever and also helping me work on and fully understand how to continue all the things my dog learned while training with Wesley. I would highly recommend Wesley to anyone looking for a dog trainer in Houston.

Wesley was absolutely phenomenal! As a dog trainer, he went above and beyond in every way, helping our Vizsla, Ingo, not just behave better, but truly thrive. His calm, confident energy and deep understanding of dog behavior made an immediate impact. He didn’t just train Ingo—he taught us essential life skills that improved our relationship with our dog and made everyday life smoother and more enjoyable. Wesley is a natural teacher, incredibly professional, has great communication skills and genuinely kind. He was a joy to work with from start to finish, and we’re beyond grateful for his guidance. We recommend him 1000%—he’s truly the best of the best!

We were stressing after getting our new Doberman puppy and talked to Wes about solutions for our very excitable dog. Wes and his team were able to spend an hour a day with him for two weeks and set a solid foundation for him.

It was night and day after working with them. We were nervous with such a large dog and having a 3 year old in the house. After they worked with him it was a huge sigh of relief and has been amazing for not only us but also not worrying about him jumping all over our toddler.

Thanks Wes!

I can't recommend Wesley enough. We sent our 9 month old puppy, Penelope, to him for a board & train and it's like she's a different dog! She walks wonderfully on a leash and is no longer reactive to other dogs and people at all. We can let her off leash at the park to play fetch and can recall her at will. She's much better in the house, where we can put her on "place" when she gets too active. She even does well in the kennel now, which she hated before. After having worked with Wesley, I wouldn't trust my dog with anyone else. Very professional, very supportive, and you can tell he's passionate about working with dogs every day.

Wesley is the best dog trainer we have ever had work with our golden retriever! Wesley has helped us work with our highly energetic adolescent golden to learn to calm himself. We recommend him highly!!!!!!

Called and spoke with Westley regarding training for my toy poodle. Had a great conversation regarding what my dog needs specifically and went over pricing. He sounds very confident, and I'm looking forward to training!

I can't recommend Wesley enough for dog training! He worked wonders with our 2 year old wire-haired pointing griffon. After 2.5 weeks he is so much more calm when he is around other dogs, on walks and much better with commands. He clearly understands dogs and by far the best trainer around.

We learned so much through our private lessons with Good DaweG! On our first lesson, Kuzco (our cavalier), struggled tremendously with pulling on leash and settling at home in a designated place. After 5 lessons we have been able to see so much improvement during our walks. Kuzco no longer takes off running the second the front door opens, is walking close to my side during majority of the walk, and we are able to get him settled in a designated “place” at home like never before. Wesley has provided us with some great tools to continue practicing and I’m very grateful! Definitely recommend!!

Wesley came to my house and in just one session, he made a noticeable difference in my dog, Betty's behavior.  His training instructions to me were clear and easily understood, and Betty loved it.  We are looking forward to the next session.

Wesley is absolutely AMAZING, he gave me excellent advice on my rescue dogs fence fighting issues. The response time was fantastic and I was at my wits end. I recommend him to anyone with any issue. He is kind, compassionate and extremely professional. If you have a pet who is struggling with a problem, he is the one to call!

I have been grooming Wesley's dog Rusty, and I've noticed his talent in training. He builds trust effortlessly with dogs, and his clients always rave about him. Wesley is straightforward, easy to communicate with, and punctual—qualities I value as a service provider and customer. I recommend him 100%

Wesley did an amazing job with my golden retriever 7 month old puppy, Finn. Finn is now able to walk next to me with leash on ground and is not reactive at all. He even stays on "place" commands until I release him. This is not typical for 7month old puppies, but Wesley put the time and work with him and Finn is now amazingly trained.  Wesley is super responsive and helpful at any time of day! 100/10 recommend him to any person looking for training. (Plus he taught Finn some party tricks that are so fun to use)
Wesley helped trained our two dogs, and we are so happy we found him! He is amazing at analyzing the dogs' behavior and pointing out why certain issues happen, what needs to be corrected, and how. …

My husband and I cannot say enough about Wesley. He took our Aussie that wanted to jump on everyone, play too rough with our grandkids, bark and want to play all the time, and was just too much to take out anywhere with us and turned him …

We adopted Balashi (Lashi) from Aruba in 2021. Over time she became very people and dog aggressive. We couldn't take her out or anything. Last year she tried to "kill" another puppy we adopted. We put her at an in-board training facility …
